$comment: Frozen record of how the Python Agent SDK's records line up with core's outbound shapes (contracts/outbound). Read by sdk/python-agent/tests/test_contracts.py. The SDK makes no HTTP call to core; its AuditEvent.to_flat_map() reuses core's AuditLogEntryResponse field names, and its ApprovalRequest mirrors ApprovalRequestResponse. Every divergence is listed here on purpose: a new one fails the test until it is added (and justified) here. Lists only shrink when the SDK and core converge.
